review_scope: Sealed exact five-core static/offline review only; independent criteria frozen before code and old verdicts.

required_findings.title: Derived worker resource policy is not checked against immutable reviewed choices
required_findings.trigger: A concurrent or manual edit to WORKER_CONTROL.json after parent construction but before worker startup changes its worker_policy while execution manifest and final gate stay unchanged.
required_findings.mechanism: Worker validates policy bounds from control.worker_policy but never compares those values to execution.effective.worker_policy. Parent accepts worker success using outcome, return flag, PID and execution-input SHA without checking requested_resource_policy or enforced limit readbacks. A valid CPU90 control therefore passes the exact worker policy fragment and exact parent acceptance predicate with a reviewed CPU2 policy and unchanged manifest binding.
required_findings.counterexample_scope: Pure extracted exact-code guard fragments and synthetic successful worker-result dictionaries. No actual prepare, execute, assess, resource setup, config/gate creation or service operation.
required_findings.repair: Require the worker control policy to equal execution.effective.worker_policy before resource setup; independently check requested policy and actual CPU/FSIZE/NOFILE readbacks against immutable choices before parent accepts success. Revalidate or derive the remaining worker control choices from the reviewed manifest/authenticated native inputs; include a mismatching-control regression normally and under optimization.
required_findings.not_claimed: No evidence of any real concurrent edit, native run or compromised host. Arbitrary host-level binary replacement is outside this review.
